SELECT r.recipe_id AS recipeId, r.owner_user_id AS ownerUserId, r.title AS title, r.is_public AS isPublic, r.is_deleted AS isDeleted, r.report_cnt AS reportCnt, r.created_date AS createdDate, u.user_nickname AS ownerNickname FROM tb_recipe r LEFT JOIN tb_user u ON r.owner_user_id = u.user_id WHERE 1=1 AND r.is_deleted = 'N'
AND (r.title LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.user_nickname LIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
AND r.is_public = 'Y'
AND r.is_public = 'N'
AND r.recipe_id < #{lastRecipeId}
ORDER BY r.recipe_id DESC
FETCH FIRST #{limit} ROWS ONLY
